asr.full_text: Hello and welcome to another update video on LINK. So the Chainlink chart is currently holding just below our resistance area. Beautiful rejection from resistance, as you may remember from the previous update. Due to the decline that we saw, which looks like a five wave decline from the Monday high. I am overall looking for lower prices. This of course needs to be confirmed with a break below the Monday low, the price which has fallen into the yellow A wave, on our microsupport around 856 and 872 by the way. So we found a low here and bounced and that bounce was expected across the sector for the main Coins, that I am looking at anyway for this week and so that already happened yesterday and now we are simply consolidating below resistance but I would not be surprised if we soon start the c-wave decline. LINK is still holding quite well though I mean we haven't got a break below the Monday low yet and I definitely want to keep the door open for a wider B wave. I mean, this is not something that I think you can predict necessarily because the move up fulfilled already requirements of the B wave bounce. And again, the yellow count is preferred, not the blue count to new highs. No, it is not at the moment. That can change if we certainly take out certain levels, but I don't see that right now. The idea is, due to this five wave decline, the market forms a B wave, the B wave ideally should end in our resistance area between $9.29 and $9.74, and then we could see one more low. I mean, this is sort of the idea. A wave, B wave, C wave, whether we form a larger B wave, or this all of it is noise, and doesn't really have an impact on structure. Structure would change if we break above $9.74 in a decisive manner and then follow the blue count again, the blue count is on the chart, it's not that it's unlikely, but it's kind of become less relevant and less likely all right and so until then the market is expected to move back into the lower support region. We have a lot of parameters here on the chart our micro support area, resistance and then the main range support. So up here this is a decision area. And if the market loses micro-support, then, yeah, the focus will shift back to the main support area. It's, by the way, the same support area we've been tracking, we've been watching throughout all of February. But what if we break below that? So if we break below $7.55, the door opens to $6.90 and lower. This is just a short-term update, but I plan to release my 2026 Outlook for Chainlink, the Q2 update. I think I updated the 2026 forecast for a lot of coins three months ago. So I want to give you an update also for Chainlink. I will do that and upload the video either later today or tomorrow on X. So I recommend that you follow us here as well. I will do that and upload the video either later today or tomorrow on X. So I recommend that you follow us here as well. I put the link into the comment section. I just uploaded, by the way, also the ADA 2026 Outlook update. It's just an update, a rolling Q2 forecast. And I will do the same for Bitcoin as well and Ethereum, so you will find them all here. And if you don't want to miss that check it out but that gives you a good idea of what's expected for q2 then also a bigger picture higher time frame outlook i just can't do them all at once so this will be you know coming out over the next few days and will hopefully create a lot of value i put the link for our x channel by the way into the comment section so that means all eyes at the moment need to be on how the market reacts to this resistance between $9.29 and $9.74. And then, yeah, also around the Monday low, we might spend a couple of more days here in this sideways range between the Monday low and our resistance, though. Not a very exciting market at the moment. But again, sometimes then it can make sense to look at the bigger picture. That's what the Q2 forecast is for. I'll keep you updated. Thanks so much. Have a great day. Bye-bye.
